subject: Aurora Health pilot: ingress projection and rollout checkpoint
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aurora Health pilot: ingress projection and rollout checkpoint

Team —

Aurora confirmed the week-of-May 30 pilot start (internal load tests May 27). They sent an initial traffic projection and a short MAP. Key asks from their side: a temporary quota uplift for the first 10 days of production traffic, a hard fallback variant that uses a smaller quantized model, and an E2E test window with sustained bursts up to ~8k rps for 10–15 minutes.

What I need from each of you by EOD:
- Neha: feasible short-term quota uplift (multiplier + how we gate it) and routing plan for reserved capacity vs hosted overflow.
- Marcus: product/SDK constraints — can we ship a rollout flag to pin the quantized variant and enable prefix warmup? Timeline?
- Laura/Grace: legal/partner/CS hooks we should surface to Aurora (SLA exception language and monitoring access).

Attachments: aurora-initial-projection.xlsx, MAP_v1.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4582

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health pilot: ingress projection and rollout checkpoint

Hi Rafael / all —

Quick capacity read: given the forecast in aurora-initial-projection.xlsx, we can provide a temporary 2.0x quota uplift on their hosted pool for the pilot window if we reserve a small Dedicated buffer (equivalent to ~20% of projected 95th). Operational notes:
- We need clear burst shaping — sustained 8k rps for >10 minutes will trigger autoscale but risks throttles if concurrent KV cache warmup is cold.
- Proposal: 2.0x temporary uplift (auto-reverts after 10 days) + sticky routing to keep warm KV state on a constrained subset of hosts.
- Need a runbook for fallback to quantized variant and soft-threshold alarms at 70%/85%/95% utilization.

Questions for Marcus:
1) Can product expose a 'prefix_cache_warmup=true' flag we can set per-customer?
2) If we pin to a quantized variant as fallback, what latency delta should Aurora expect (p50/p95)?

Cc'ing Laura for legal/SLA implications.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Capacity Planning Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Aurora Health pilot: ingress projection and rollout checkpoint

Thanks — some product context and commitments from product infra: 

- Prefix cache warmup flag: we can reasonably ship a per-customer flag that nudges the KV prefill behavior. It is a lightweight server-side flag and we can have it staged to prod within 4 business days (ETA May 26).
- Rollout flag for quantized variant: we can add a constrained "pin_model_variant" toggle that will route traffic to the 4-bit quantized variant on demand. Latency tradeoffs: expect +10–15ms p50, +60–80ms p95 relative to the main float16 variant for the model Aurora plans to use (based on our benchmark).
- Soft-limit behavior: we'll provide a short-term soft limit implementation (throttle advisory + headers) that allows 5–10% overshoot for warmup but enforces hard limit beyond that. I attached a small proposal for the rollout flag implementation.

Action items: Marcus to drive the flag rollout (rollout-flag-proposal.patch). Neha to validate buffer sizing and define alarms. Laura to confirm SLA wording needed for the temporary uplift.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Product Manager, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Folks —

Summarizing the decisions so we have a single source of truth before I reply to Aurora:
1) Quota uplift: Redwood will provision a temporary 2.0x quota uplift on hosted for Aurora starting May 30, auto-reverts to baseline after 10 days. Neha will create the uplift ticket and the rollback timer.
2) Routing: Sticky routing to a reserved subset to keep KV warm; overflow to hosted will be allowed with soft-limit policy (5–10% overshoot) configured.
3) Product flags: Marcus to ship prefix_cache_warmup and pin_model_variant toggles; ETA May 26 for the warmup flag, May 28 for pinning toggle rollout to prod.
4) Fallback variant: quantized fallback will be available; expected latency delta ~+10–15ms p50, +60–80ms p95 — we will capture exact numbers in the MAP.
5) E2E test: we can support a 15-minute burst test up to 8k rps on May 27 as a conditional run; Neha to validate capacity immediately and confirm by May 24.
6) Legal/SLA: Laura to draft a brief SLA addendum outlining tolerated latency delta and temporary uplift window; Grace to coordinate doc delivery.

Attachments: final-MAP.pdf (consolidated MAP with timeline).
Dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/aurora-uptick
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4582
Jira: OPS-1293

I'll respond back to Sanjay with this plan and include Laura for the SLA language. If anyone sees critical gaps, flag them now.

— Rafael
